work_experiences.job_description: Build and deploy a robust machine-learning pipeline for efficient data processing and modeling. Continuously improve the performance and scalability of the pipeline for accurate predictive modeling. Contribute to the development and publication of research papers based on findings from data science projects. Collaborate with researchers and prepare clear documentation to effectively communicate research outcomes. Conduct in-depth research and develop innovative solutions for classification, clus

Did an extensive survey on pre-existing, state-of-the-art Time Series Clustering methods. Worked on Implementing a Clustering-based Outlier Detection technique for Time Series Datasets. I developed a prototype of an Active Learning-based Clustering model to remove and classify outliers from Time Series Datasets. I also surveyed Pre-Existing Anomaly Detection software tools and Deep Learning Models for Time Series Annotation, Clustering, and Classification

I developed a solution for the all-new Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 (yet to be released), within 3 months and surpassing the pre-existing model with an accuracy of 96%. I implemented a Deep Learning Neural Network to estimate the length of each step using the Accelerometer readings from the Galaxy Watch 6. The implemented solution reached an accuracy of 96%, predicting each step's length with an error of only 6-9cm.

projects.title: Designing and Implementing Robotic Arm for the Physically Disabled

details.description: We implemented a Robotic arm using ABS polymer for physically disabled individuals to identify and pick up objects in real-time environments using Voice Recognition. Used Deep Learning Algorithms like Mask RCNN to detect and identify objects using the Kinect Camera and localized these objects for the arm to reach, pick up, and drop the objects.

Implemented my version of a voice-controlled virtual assistant like Google Assistant and Alexa for PCs and Laptops, This was developed using Python. Libraries Used: pyttsx3, speech_recogition, pywhatkit, smtplib

Driver Drowsiness Detection is a Safety mechanism that helps prevent accidents caused by sleepy drivers. Our objective was to develop a security system that alerts the driver when drowsiness is detected. Libraries Used: OpenCV, Keras, Tensorflow, and Numpy. We used the CNN Model built with Keras. We used OpenCV to get input from the webcam and feed the data to the CNN model, which will classify if the person's eyes are 'Open' or 'Closed'.

technical_papers.title: Game-Based Learning System for Improvising Student’s Learning Effectively: A Survey

details.description: This study contributes to the ongoing research on the use of gaming features for the development of innovative methodologies in teaching and learning. This study aims to shed light on the factors and characteristics to be considered when implementing a game-based learning system. This study provides valuable insight to future researchers and game designers with issues and problems related to educational game design and implementation.

details.description: This project involves the control of electrical appliances with the help of an Android Application through Internet. The project also includes modules like; Automatic LPG Reservation System, Soil Moisture Sensing System and water level detection system

projects.title: IoT based Traffic Density identification system using Raspberry PI

details.description: In this project ultrasonic sensors are used to determine the traffic density on particular lane and hence notify the driver to take an alternative path to reach the destination. An Android app is developed for the driver side which gives notification regarding traffically congested areas of the city with the help of cloud services

work_experiences.job_description: Considering a research paper on optimizing resource utilization in FCVN(Fog-Enabled Connected Vehicular Network) as a base we have added additional multiple objectives like energy to it and made the complex optimizations more efficient using Reinforcement Learning. A research paper that was written got published in an International IEEE GUCON Conference. Created our custom library using event simulation library simpy due to unavailability of a suitable library in python and make it open-source for further development.
Developed an AI system that can detect the detective tires of a tractor employing machine learning (3D-CNN). Worked on TensorFlow, Developed the model to deploy on a website using NodeJS

details.description: Designed an algorithm to detect the people wearing a mask or not using tensorflow.
Created amazon website which contains features dynamically.
Designed an ER diagram for social networking database, implemented and tested on database using oracleSQL which is a part of DBMS course project
Implemented the adam optimization algorithm from scartch by reading its research paper in python using pytorch. This project was a part of datascience course project.

work_experiences.job_description: As a Machine Learning Intern at Knowledge Solutions India, I built a Supervised Machine Learning model for predicting house prices in the Bangalore area. Using data on house features such as location, size, and amenities. Overall, this project provided me with valuable experience in data cleaning, feature engineering, model selection, and deployment. It also allowed me to contribute to the real-world problem of accurately predicting house prices, helping people make informed decisions.

details.description:
The Used Car Price Prediction System is a Python Flask project that runs a Gradient
Boosting Regressor algorithm on a dataset. It also interfaces with a database for
storing and retrieving car-related data. This method delivers reliable used
car price predictions based on different factors and previous data.

In this project, an "e-commerce website" is developed virtually. It gives the user a list of all the different goods that are sold in the store. The customer is given access to a shopping cart for the convenience of online shopping. After making a choice, the user can place an order by logging in or by using a guest account.

work_experiences.job_description: SAP Integration Consultant

details.description: It is an international dairy cooperative based in Amersfoort, Netherlands. My significant work in this project includes migrating 100+ interfaces from SAP PI to SAP CPI. This task helped me connect with multiple business personnel and teams, maintain empathy, and work to make the interfaces go live. Working on change requests to create and modify interfaces according to user requirements helped me understand the specific requirements and actions needed to achieve them.

technical_papers.title: Criminal behavior analysis and segmentation using machine learning

details.description:
This paper focuses on crime analysis by implementing a clustering algorithm
on crime, dataset using the rapid miner tool and here we do crime analysis by considering
crime homicide and plotting it concerning year and got to the conclusion that
homicide is decreasing from 1990 to 2011 . From the clustered results it is easy to
identify crime trends over the years and can be used to design precaution methods for
future.

projects.title: A Study on Toxicity Mechanisms of Xenobiotics using Network Pharmacology Approach

details.description: To study the Toxicity Mechanisms of Xenobiotics

projects.title: A Study on Toxicity Mechanisms of Xenobiotics Using Network Pharmacology Approach

details.description: Harnessing network pharmacology and data from PubChem, PharmMapper, KEGG, PANTHER pathway, and Cytoscape, this study delved into the toxicity mechanisms of xenobiotics, revealing key targets and pathways linked to oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis. Integrating diverse data sources, the study unveiled potential drug repurposing strategies and identified novel therapeutic targets.

projects.title: Incorporation of aluminium dross in Flexible pavements

details.description:
In the construction of flexible pavements, the aluminium dross is added to asphalt with the course aggregate weight.
By heating the aggregates,filler,bitumen, aluminium dross maintaining 170°c by using heat plate. The Marshall stability test can be used to determine the flow values and voids percentages .

conventional roads.

work_experiences.job_description:
• Managed and executed all alumni communications, including biannual publications, event invitations, and general updates, reaching over 100,000 alumni.
• Planned and coordinated alumni reunions, overseeing logistics, budgeting, and marketing, resulting in a 20% increase in attendance.
• Oversaw the organization's social media presence, increasing engagement by 15% through targeted content and strategic scheduling.

• Used specialized software and Microsoft Excel to update alumni records from 1960 to 2003.
• Conducted quality control checks on data entry to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
• Collaborated with team members to troubleshoot technical issues and streamline data entry processes,
resulting in a 20% increase in efficiency.

• Strategically targeted potential sponsors to solicit donations, resulting in an increase in campaign funding and over $1,000 in contributions.
• Provided on-the-ground support during the election process, collecting voter signatures and assisting with ballot distribution to facilitate a smooth and successful election day.
• Demonstrated strong communication, project management, and fundraising skills, working collaboratively with campaign staff to achieve shared goals.

• Developed startup ideas using Agile methodologies to identify and address unmet market needs, resulting in several viable product concepts.
• Created professional wireframe mock-ups of apps using Adobe XD, improving the visual representation of products for stakeholder presentations.
• Demonstrated an understanding of FDA and HIPAA regulations to design and build a Minimum Viable Product within six-week sprints, resulting in successful development and deployment of several innovative products.

• Initiated and led the organization of a TEDx event with 200 guests, 10 speakers, and a 12-member team, managing a budget of $10,000.
• Adapted event strategy to incorporate the effects of COVID-19, implementing innovative solutions such as virtual attendance options and increased health and safety measures.
• Demonstrated strong leadership skills, effectively delegating tasks and managing a diverse team of volunteers to ensure a smooth and successful event.

work_experiences.job_description:
UCLOUD to Foundry Data Integration.
Role – Data Engineer 1
Objective: To build new data integration pipeline between different source systems to Foundry Palantir via UCLOUD (AWS).

1) Build data ingestion pipeline from Source Systems to AWS S3 bucket via Glue jobs.
2) Build ingestion from AWS S3 to RAW Bucket via ICON Framework, then it will be migrated to Curated Bucket.
3) Data Sync to Foundry Palantir from Curated layer.
4) Responsible for the build and test results and end to end delivery.
Tech Stack:– Python, Spark, SQL Server, AWS S3, AirFlow, AThena, AWS RDS, ICON Framework, Foundry Palantir.

1. Worked  in  the  Embedded  QA  team  on  device  upgrade  automation  and  feature  testing.
2. Developed  and  Tested  automation  scripts  using  Python  and  robot  Framework to ensure product quality developed in sprint-based agile environment.
3. Progress  reporting,  Workflow  customization,  Issue  management  in  JIRA.

details.description: With a little OpenCV, Python, and Tesseract OCR knowledge, you could help homeowners' association in monitoring cars that pass from your neighbourhood. You could use a Raspberry Pi to build a camera-based (radar-free) system that determines the speed of cars passing by your house. If the vehicle exceeds the speed limit, you can analyse the licence plate, apply OCR to it, and record the licence plate number in a database. A system like this could help reduce speeding violations and improve safety

In this project, a data set is created based on various high and low vitamin values, and features are divided into normal and abnormal vitamin conditions, and labels are divided into 0 and 1 as normal and abnormal.Another dataset is being created based on the combination of various vitamins and their deficiencies, as well as food to be recommended based on which vitamin is deficient.
	Multiple classifier algorithms are used in this project. Algo is used to combine multiple algo and train new one

Research apprentice under the professors Dr. Devika Rubi and Dr. Rajasekaran.
The purpose of the project was to create an all-around website- android application which would be able to predict COVID-19 regions from CT- SCANS.
I was a part of the radiology team where I was responsible in assisting the running the R-AI-DIOLOGY website and researched in detail about NIFFLER which is a frontend framework for medical image viewing

details.description:
The library performs all calculator operations using non-negative integer of arbitrary length. The
non-negative integer is read as a string and operations are performed on it in an efficient and effective way to return
back the result. The library also supports operations such as factorial, greatest common divisor, modulus, nth
fibonacci number, power raised to any number and many more.

An online ticket booking system implemented using Python and SQLAlchemy
for a theatre with multiple auditoriums and screenings associated with each auditorium with the support of APIs to
make requests to the backend server. Relational Database is developed using SQLAlchemy which gives the flexibility
to choose among all the available Relational Database.

A C++ Mini-Compiler implemented using Python Lex-Yacc that supports the syntax and
semantics of C++ for the constructs if, if-else and switch. Also supports all valid C++ programs with arithmetic
expressions, declaration statements (including arrays), assignment expressions and handles arithmetic expressions
which involves arithmetic operators, logical operators and assignment operators.

Implemented Google’s Page Rank Algorithm using a Map Reduce
job using Python that runs on Hadoop’s file system. MapReduce job that finds the Rank of all the websites with the
help of Hadoop’s MapReduce framework. Makes use of matrix vector multiplication in order to find the rank of a
corresponding page. MapReduce task is executed until convergence.

The framework is implemented using Python, Threading and
Mutex-Locks with a master-slave architecture consists of one Master, which runs on a dedicated machine and manages
the resources of the rest of the machines in the cluster. Other machines in the cluster have one worker process running
on each of them. The master process makes the scheduling decisions while the worker executes the task and informs
the completion of a task.

A Relational Database that manages multiple franchises of a group
implemented using relational database MySQL. Database keeps track of all the employees, customers and transactions
corresponding to each to branch and customer are maintained.

technical_papers.title: An Enhanced Deployment of 5G Network Using Multi Objective Genetic Algorithm

details.description:
This paper deals with deploying base stations inside a fixed area and optimizing their locations to provide good coverage to users
using a heuristic approach similar to genetic algorithms.

technical_papers.title: Comparative study of Neural Networks for Emergency Vehicle Detection

details.description: This study explores the application of Neural Networks for efficient emergency vehicle identification. Utilizing a dataset of emergency and non-emergency vehicle images, the model demonstrates high accuracy in classification. A noteworthy use case involves real-time integration with traffic systems, where the identification of an emergency vehicle triggers an automatic change of traffic lights to green, facilitating swift and unimpeded passage.

work_experiences.job_description: Developing Flask APIs and MySQL database as the backend for a Machine Learning Operation product that handles the entire Machine Learning pipeline, from data visualization to model production monitoring, thus helping data scientists and business managers streamline their Machine Learning workflows.

Performed multiclass classification to identify defects on in the images of semiconductor chips. Used PCA and Kmeans clustering to balance unbalanced dataset during data preprocessing. Performed transfer learning on pretrained RESNET50 model to achieve validation accuracy of 72.5%.

Tensorflow and neural network training.Debugging the framework for automating neural network and tensorflow scripts.Running experiments with the tensorflow scripts produced by the framework.Manipulating data and neural network structure and specs to optimize accuracy in the neural networks. Analyse the results from training the neural network models to better understand and improve the models and frameworks.

Architected a full-stack web application that helps a pharmacist manage daily tasks, patients and their prescriptions. Designed and deployed data pipelines using microservices based architecture for data ingestion and retrieval. Built and managed backend database system, designed front-end user interface using React JavaScript and developed a modular codebase using object-oriented programming concepts.

Implemented a conversational AI Chatbot for a hospital that facilitates scheduling appointments and provides solutions to real-time queries. Utilized open source machine learning framework called RASA that leveraged LSTM model and deployed it via Slack API integration.

details.description:
Designed a Deep Learning model that performed facial expression classification in real time using a web camera.
Developed a CNN model(test accuracy achieved 75%) using Tensorflow and OpenCV Haar Cascade that beat
VGG16 baseline model(test accuracy achieved 71%) which was transfer learned on our data.

Developed a Siamese Deep Network called MaLSTM ( Manhattan LSTM ) to detect similarity between two sentences.
The trained network achieved test accuracy of 72%

Classified genes using lncRNA samples into cancerous and non-cancerous groups.
Tested and compared performances of Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, k-nearest neighbors, Support Vector
Machines, Random Forests and XGBoost.
Improved the classification performance by using Stacking as an ensemble learning method which provided the best
ROC-AUC value of 0.85, as compared to the baseline models.

projects.title: Comparative Study on Microstructure and Mechanical properties of Aluminum Alloy Weldments Using GTAW and CMT

details.description: Since welding of Aluminium Alloys is one of the difficult tasks using the GTAW process since the number of layers has to deposit, probably increasing the high heat input and the chance of porosity and HAZ cracks, and there is decreasing the mechanical properties.
